action.content: Write a song about innovation with a positive tone that is appealing to teenagers. Put your entire response in double quotation marks.
action.label: context

action.content:
"Verse 1:
Waking up to a world that's changing fast,
Got a spark in my pocket, yeah, it's built to last.
Old rules are fading, we're rewriting the code,
Carrying the future on a digital road.

Chorus:
We're the innovators, breaking every chain,
Turning up the volume, feeling the rain.
From a sketch on a napkin to a global dream,
Nothing's impossible when we're living the scheme.
Yeah, we're building tomorrow, one idea at a time,
Leaving all the doubt and the fear behind.

Verse 2:
Glitch in the system? That's just a new start,
We're the architects of a brand new heart.
Coding up the rhythm, mixing up the beat,
Making sure that every single voice is sweet.

Bridge:
Don't wait for permission, don't ask for a sign,
The power is in your hands, it's yours to define.
Connect the dots, let the creativity flow,
Watch the whole world rise as the seeds start to grow.

Chorus:
We're the innovators, breaking every chain,
Turning up the volume, feeling the rain.
From a sketch on a napkin to a global dream,
Nothing's impossible when we're living the scheme.
Yeah, we're building tomorrow, one idea at a time,
Leaving all the doubt and the fear behind.

Outro:
So grab your mic, grab your pen, grab your phone,
We're the new generation, we're never alone.
Innovation's calling, and we're ready to go,
Watch us light up the sky, watch the whole world glow."
action.label: response
